name: hud_ui_options_panel_music_volume_on_activate
description: HudUiOptionsPanel_MusicVolume::OnActivate derives the music-volume slider value from the cursor and writes both CD AUX channels through zSndCd::SetVolume.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HUD options-panel source-file/table cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40cd00 calls HudUiFillBitmap::UpdateNormalizedFromCursor, converts normalizedValue * 65535.0f to an unsigned short via _ftol, and passes the same value to zSndCd::SetVolume for primary and secondary channels.

Native smoke zhud_options_panel_music_volume_on_activate_smoke patches zSndCd::SetVolume, verifies cursor-derived normalizedValue 0.25f, verifies the fill-bitmap rebuild, and verifies SetVolume receives the same converted 16-bit value for both channels.
